svg.title: Explicit native connection, registered origin and Intel Web session
svg.desc: The Mac user explicitly selects a gateway profile, a protected owned child and a current LAN or VPN interface. Authenticated readiness and capability checks do not start infrastructure or register a workspace. An explicit ensure request is journaled before HTTP and genuinely creates or reuses the backend binding; only a validated receipt yields a canonical IP:basename Connect ID. The user opens the configured Intel Web Connect form and supplies that existing ID. The web server uses its separately authorized relay credential to resolve the same backend registration and creates a bounded opaque session. Protected rendering, requests and live connections revalidate current authority and revision. Collisions never take over another binding; uncertain outcomes retain the exact pending request. Gateway or credential changes clear old client authority, and an IP change requires explicit rebind and current registration rather than invented local success.
svg.text: Choose the destination, register the origin, then connect Intel Web
MAC CLIENT · EXPLICIT CHOICES AND AUTHENTICATED REGISTRATION

Gateway profile + origin-bound credential file

Validate deployment, purpose and permissions

Validate receipt, stable IDs and current revisions

svg.text: INTEL WEB · EXISTING-ID LOOKUP, NEVER BROWSER REGISTRATION

g.text: Intel Web Connect form
GET /connect · POST /api/connect
User supplies a previously registered Connect ID
Explicit public web origin, separate from upstream
No token in URL, JavaScript or browser storage
Authoritative existing-ID lookup
POST /api/v1/connect/sessions
Server-only WebRelay + ResolveWebSession
Configured backend validates current registration
Unknown / revoked IDs fail closed; no auto-create
Opaque session + current context
Host-only HttpOnly cookie; Secure on HTTPS
Revalidate render, API, export and live access
Mutations pin context revision; old tabs get 409
Connect ID selects context; it is not a credential
Collision, outage or uncertain HTTP outcome
Collision: do not take over another binding or invent a receipt.
Unknown ensure / rebind: keep the exact journaled attempt.
Reconcile that request; keep local files and removal pending.
Unavailable or revoked web authority never opens protected data.
An error is not a reason to register a new browser workspace.
Reconnect or explicitly rebind
Destination / credential changes clear old data and proof references.
Re-run authenticated checks with the explicitly selected profile.
IP change requires confirmed rebind; former sessions are revoked.
Refresh current child registration; preserve immutable old-job origin.
No implicit stack startup, service install or local success fabrication.

svg.text: Remote public HTTPS requires its configured authentication ingress; the relay's internal upstream remains separate.
Source contract only. Installed Mac launch, real authentication ingress and complete deployment journeys need their own evidence.
